title: Business Analyst
description:
A signed SOW is only as good as what happens to it next. This role exists to be the critical bridge between Sales, Project Intake, and Delivery Execution — making sure every signed project enters development with clarity, completeness, and functional accuracy, instead of ambiguity that surfaces three weeks into a build.
 



  





 You’ll convert signed SOWs, discovery notes, and client requirements into structured, developer\-ready documentation. Your work directly protects delivery efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction by catching gaps before development begins, not after.
 



  





***This role is for someone who enjoys:***



* Turning ambiguous requirements into precise, structured documentation
* Catching gaps and inconsistencies before they become delivery problems
* Working at the intersection of Sales, PMs, Developers, and QA
* Building reusable systems and templates rather than solving the same problem repeatedly



  





 If you’re someone who takes real satisfaction in a requirement document that leaves zero room for misinterpretation, this role will put that skill to constant use.
 



  





**What you’ll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Project Intake \& Transition** 



* Review signed SOWs, proposals, discovery notes, and transcripts
* Participate in internal kick\-off sessions to understand client priorities and technical constraints
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, or missing inputs before development begins
* Ensure complete transition from Sales to Delivery with zero requirement blind spots



  





**2\. Requirement Documentation** 



* Translate business requirements into Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and detailed User Stories
* Break down modules and features into data fields, validations, workflows, interactions, and conditional logic
* Define dynamic content behavior, click actions, role\-based access views, and system logic
* Ensure documentation is structured, version\-controlled, and delivery\-ready



  





**3\. Internal Task Structuring \& Execution Alignment** 



* Collaborate with Project Managers to convert requirements into structured development tasks (ClickUp, Jira, etc.)
* Identify task dependencies and logical execution sequences
* Support QA teams with initial test case outlines derived from business rules and acceptance criteria



  





**4\. Client Clarifications \& Change Management** 



* Track and document clarification requests during execution
* Support PMs and Account Managers in evaluating scope deviations and change requests
* Maintain version\-controlled documentation with client confirmations and change logs



  





**5\. Quality \& UAT Support** 



* Assist PMs in validating completed work against functional documentation before client delivery
* Participate in internal UAT cycles to ensure alignment between build and documented requirements
* Reduce last\-minute surprises during client reviews



  





**6\. Documentation Governance \& Hygiene** 



* Maintain centralized repositories of requirement documents and change logs
* Ensure consistent formatting, naming conventions, and version control standards
* Regularly clean up outdated or deprecated documentation references



  





**7\. Proactive Risk Identification** 



* Identify risks, inconsistencies, and vague requirements early in the process
* Escalate potential delivery blockers before development begins
* Flag redundant or unclear SOW elements that may lead to misinterpretation



  





**8\. Cross\-Department Collaboration** 



* Work closely with UI/UX designers to ensure designs align with documented functionality
* Annotate design files and provide developer\-facing logic notes
* Clarify workflow expectations and display conditions across teams



  





**9\. Process \& Template Improvement** 



* Refine internal templates for FRDs, change tracking, and requirement mapping
* Recommend process improvements to reduce friction during handoffs
* Improve intake efficiency through structured documentation patterns



  





**10\. Knowledge Sharing \& Reusability** 



* Document recurring modules, platform constraints, and reusable logic patterns
* Build and maintain an internal knowledge base for delivery reference
* Support onboarding by providing structured background documentation



**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You catch ambiguity and gaps before anyone else notices them
* You write documentation precisely enough that a developer never has to guess
* You move comfortably between Sales, PMs, Developers, and QA without losing context
* You maintain documentation discipline even when things get busy
* You think in reusable systems, not one\-off fixes



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in a digital agency, web development, or software delivery environment



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong experience creating FRDs, user stories, process flows, and QA outlines
* Ability to convert business requirements into clear, structured, developer\-ready documentation
* Strong analytical thinking and logical reasoning skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Exceptional attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Strong understanding of website or application development lifecycles



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Figma, Jira, ClickUp, Miro, Lucidchart, Confluence
* Google Workspace



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience working with US\-based agencies or white\-label service models
* Familiarity with SOWs, BRDs, technical specifications, and structured discovery documentation
* Understanding of WordPress, Shopify, custom PHP/JS builds, and API integrations
* Ability to annotate UI/UX designs and suggest usability improvements
* Knowledge of risk management, prioritization frameworks, and delivery dependency mapping



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-impact role sitting at the center of Sales, Delivery, and Client Success
* Ownership of the documentation that determines how smoothly every project runs

* Room to shape and improve internal documentation standards and templates

 **data\-driven operating system for our manufacturing plants**

 **data, artificial intelligence and automation to improve plant productivity, reduce operating costs and make faster, better management decisions.**

**Location:**

  Full\-time \| On\-site
 




**Department:**

 We are looking for an

 **structured data, actionable intelligence and management decisions** 
 .
 
 A significant amount of plant information currently comes through 
 **WhatsApp messages, shift reports, production sheets, maintenance reports, laboratory reports, utility records and other Excel/data sheets** 
 .
 



 The core objective of this role is to bring all of this information together and answer:
 



**What happened?** 




**Why did it happen?** 




**What is the financial/operational impact?** 




**What action is required?** 




**Who is responsible?** 




**Has the action been completed?** 




**This is not a conventional MIS or data\-entry position** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can use

 Key Responsibilities1\. Convert WhatsApp \& Plant Reports into Intelligence

* Convert unstructured messages into structured operational data.

 **Plant Intelligence Reports** 
 .

 The objective is to move from 
 **"collecting reports" to "generating intelligence."**

 Analyze plant data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Electricity consumption
* Steam consumption
* Fuel consumption
* Energy consumption per MT of production
* Compressed air and utility losses
* Equipment running losses
* Abnormal energy consumption



 The candidate should be able to identify questions such as:
 



**Why has energy consumption per MT increased?** 




**Which equipment or process is responsible?** 




**Where are we losing energy?** 




**What corrective action can reduce the cost?** 



 3\. Improve Manufacturing Efficiency
 
 Analyze production data to identify:
 


* Production efficiency
* Batch\-wise performance
* Production delays
* Downtime
* Process deviations
* Recurring operational problems
* Production losses
* Raw\-material consumption
* Yield variations



 The candidate will work closely with 
 **Production, Maintenance, Utilities, ETP and Plant Management teams** 
 .
 


 4\. Maintenance \& Breakdown Intelligence
 
 Create a structured system to track:
 


* Equipment breakdowns
* Downtime
* Maintenance requests
* Preventive maintenance
* Corrective actions
* Root\-cause analysis
* Spare\-parts requirements
* Repeated equipment failures
* Pending maintenance activities



 The system should clearly show:
 



**Issue → Responsible Person → Target Date → Action → Status → Closure** 




**Management should be able to immediately identify overdue and recurring problems** 
 .
 


 5\. Pollution \& Environmental Data
 
 Analyze operational and environmental data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Pollution load
* SO₂/SO₃\-related emissions
* Acid mist
* Effluent load
* Waste generation
* Chemical losses
* Abnormal operating conditions



 The objective is to use data to identify 
 **the operating conditions that contribute to higher pollution and develop preventive actions.** 



 6\. Manpower \& Labour Productivity
 
 Analyze manpower deployment against production and plant requirements.
 



 Identify:
 


* Idle manpower
* Overtime
* Shift\-wise manpower utilization
* Repetitive manual activities
* Opportunities for automation
* Labour productivity
* Manpower requirements by activity/process



 The objective is to improve 
 **manpower utilization and operational productivity** 
 .
 


 Build a Digital Plant Monitoring Application
 
 A major part of this role will be to help develop a 
 **web\-based application for plant operations and issue management** 
 .
 



 The application should eventually allow plant personnel to enter and monitor:
 


* Daily production
* Shift production
* Raw\-material consumption
* Energy consumption
* Utility consumption
* Quality parameters
* Breakdown information
* Maintenance activities
* ETP/environmental parameters
* Manpower deployment
* Corrective actions



 The candidate may build the application directly using appropriate technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, or work with external developers to implement the system.
 


 Management Dashboard \& AI Reporting
 
 The ultimate objective is to create a management dashboard that can answer, at any time:
 


 Plant Performance
 * What was produced?
* What was the target?
* What was the variance?


 Energy
 * Energy consumption/MT?
* Is it improving or deteriorating?
* Where is the abnormal consumption?


 Maintenance
 * What broke down?
* How much production was lost?
* Which problems are recurring?
* What actions are overdue?


 Environment
 * Are pollution parameters within expected levels?
* What operational factors are affecting them?


 Management Actions
 * What are today's critical issues?
* Who is responsible?
* What is overdue?
* What requires management intervention?


 Skills \& Qualifications
 
 Candidates with experience or knowledge in some or all of the following will be preferred:
 


* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI / Tableau
* Data cleaning and analysis
* Dashboard development
* Python
* Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI
* AI agents and automation
* APIs and database integration
* Web application development
* Process automation
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence



 Experience in 
 **chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, process industries, manufacturing or industrial operations** 
  will be an advantage.
 



 However, we are equally interested in candidates who may not have extensive manufacturing experience but demonstrate 
 **exceptional analytical ability, technology skills and the ability to understand real\-world business problems.** 



 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are 
 **not looking for someone who simply prepares reports and dashboards** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can look at plant data and ask:
 


**Where are we losing money?** 
**Why is this happening?** 
**Can we predict it before it happens again?** 
**Can AI automate the monitoring and follow\-up?** 
**What action should management take?** 

 The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with 
 **plant operations and senior management** 
  and build systems that have a measurable impact on the company's manufacturing operations.
 


 Success in this role will be measured by real business outcomes:
 * Lower energy cost per MT
* Lower production downtime
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns
* Better manpower utilization
* Reduction in pollution load
* Faster closure of plant issues
* Improved production efficiency
* Automation of manual reporting
